stoned.songTitle: A Simple Desultory Philippic (Or How I Was Robert McNamara’d into Submission)
stoned.line: But it's alright, Ma! Everybody must get stoned
stanza: I knew a man, his brain so small
He couldn't think of nothing at all
Not the same as you and me
He doesn't dig poetry, he's so unhip when you say Dylan
He thinks you're talking about Dylan Thomas, whoever he was
The man ain't got no culture
But it's alright, Ma! Everybody must get stoned

stoned.line: I am so far from home and I feel a little stoned
stanza: Can I stay here with you till the morning?
I am so far from home and I feel a little stoned
Can I stay here with you till the morning?
There's nothing I want more than to wake up on your floor
